primary_title: Glia maturation factor induces interleukin-33 release from astrocytes: implications for neurodegenerative diseases
decision_basis: The reviews identify IL-33 as a CNS glial inflammatory mediator; the cited primary directly measures IL-33-induced CCL2 release from primary mouse astrocytes.
limitations_preserved: CNS inflammatory comparator; preserve primary mouse astrocyte and recombinant IL-33 context, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting or a universal ST2-to-ERK necessity claim.

primary_title: IL4-driven microglia modulate stress resilience through BDNF-dependent neurogenesis
decision_basis: The review context links IL-4/STAT6 microglial polarization to neurotrophic output; the cited primary measures IL-4-stimulated microglial BDNF expression and secretion and shows BDNF-dependent neural-progenitor effects.
limitations_preserved: Stress/neurogenesis comparator; preserve IL-4-stimulated microglia and BDNF/TrkB blockade context, and do not infer SCI relevance or a single STAT6 terminal mechanism.

primary_title: Interleukin-27 promotes inflammatory and neuroprotective responses in microglia
decision_basis: The reviews provide the IL-27 receptor/signaling and CNS immune context; the cited primary shows IL-27 enhances TNF-alpha production only in LPS-activated primary microglia.
limitations_preserved: Co-stimulation-dependent microglial amplifier; preserve LPS requirement and do not represent IL-27 as sufficient in unstimulated microglia or infer SCI receiver weighting.
